comment: Toggle: The player's size shrinks the further from the water's surface they are.
comment2: Compress rate proposed in #1341 may be too weak for this ability to be useful (i.e: the player would be 90% their size at 60 blocks deep).
comment3: After 8 blocks, every 4 blocks shrinks 2%, clamp at 32%. (8 depth = 100%, 28 depth = 90%, 144 depth = 32%)
